note: A current retain, replace or delete decision belongs to one rule and records its concrete counterexample, supported scope, trade-off and deciding round. The previous bulk category reasons remain in Git history, not as current evidence. Repeated checks of one SDD revision do not advance a review window.

dispositions.counterexample: With debt advisory every level admits every round kind, so the refusal could never fire; the code already left the sources and the constant ADMITTED_KINDS table that stood in for it is deleted in this round.
dispositions.tradeoff: A high debt no longer blocks rounds; it is reported by health and update and settled by consolidation rounds like this one.
